statement: The Pt. Leo Estate complimentary sculpture park entry offer for local residents ran on weekdays from 1 June 2026 to 31 August 2026.
note: Settled. The record carried a start date of 1 July 2026; the operator and the Shire both publish 1 June. The startDate and month fields are corrected by this pilot and the correction is traceable to the two evidence rows on this claim. The record also carries nextOccurrence 2026-09-16, which falls after the offer ended; that field is cron recomputed, so it is reported rather than edited here. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 pilot on the Pt. Leo Estate sculpture park cluster. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-pt-leo-sculpture-park.md.
